reading.body:
Microsoft does not publish power capacity, square footage, or specific technical specifications for individual Azure data center campuses, including PHX-12 in Goodyear. The facility's capacity is therefore unknown and cannot be compared to the published 512 MW of total capacity across Arizona's four facilities with disclosed figures.

PHX-12 sits within Microsoft's Goodyear campus in Maricopa County, which the company has expanded with an additional 100 acres of land purchase. The campus is one of 56 mapped data center facilities in Arizona, though most publish no capacity figures. Without disclosed specifications, this campus cannot be ranked by power or modeled for rack and accelerator count.

Microsoft's disclosure policy of reporting only worldwide aggregate statistics means individual campuses remain opaque to capacity planning analysis. For readers assessing Arizona's role in AI infrastructure scaling, only the four operators publishing individual campus figures contribute to the state's visible capacity picture. PHX-12's actual significance to grid constraint and AI workload placement cannot be determined from available data.
